name: Winchesters Grill & Saloon
bio: Winchesters Grill & Saloon is a steakhouse and saloon on East Main Street in downtown Ventura, open since 1997, with around 40 beers on tap and a large patio. It hosts live music Thursday through Sunday.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from @winchestersgrill, its Facebook and Visit Ventura.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
